from common import *
import pandas as pd
import shutil
def main():
 source(__file__);source(TMP/'common.py')
 rule=sys.argv[1];assert rule in ['ladder','s5']
 harness('check')
 state=read(PROGRESS);assert time.time()<state['deadline'];assert len(state['jobs'])<state['max_account_jobs'];assert not any(j['status']=='running' for j in state['jobs'])
 assert not any(j['rule']==rule and j['status']=='succeeded' for j in state['jobs'])
 manifest=read(MB/'configs/model-manifest.json');check(manifest['ensemble'])
 pred=ROOT/manifest['ensemble']['path'];config=BT/'configs'/f'{rule}.yaml';note=f'quantile10v5_20261107_{rule}'
 result_root=ROOT/'backtest/result';before={p.name for p in result_root.iterdir()}
 job={'job_id':note+'-a'+str(1+sum(j['rule']==rule for j in state['jobs'])),'rule':rule,'status':'running','started_at':time.time(),'pid':os.getpid(),'source_pred':fp(pred),'config':fp(config)}
 state['jobs'].append(job);write(PROGRESS,state)
 harness('event',{'type':'note','text':'Supplementary start '+job['job_id']+'; actual model_ref '+MODEL_ID+'; zero new fits.'})
 try:
  import qlib
  from backtest.scripts.evaluate import run_pred_backtest as bt
  from backtest.scripts.evaluate.strategy_stability_metrics import summarize_stability,load_regime_labels
  from backtest.scripts.train.train_regime_arm import frame_signature
  original_init=qlib.init
  def init(*a,**kw):kw['kernels']=1;return original_init(*a,**kw)
  qlib.init=init
  original_prepare=bt.prepare_signal_and_port_cfg
  def prepare(cfg,raw):
   port,filtered,stats=original_prepare(cfg,raw)
   write(BT/'docs'/f'{rule}-signal.json',{'source':fp(pred),'raw':frame_signature(raw),'filtered':frame_signature(filtered),'filter_stats':stats,'strategy_class':port['strategy']['class'],'strategy_kwargs':{k:v for k,v in port['strategy']['kwargs'].items() if k!='signal'},'strategy_source':fp(ROOT/'qlib/contrib/strategy/signal_strategy.py'),'ledger_source':fp(ROOT/'qlib/contrib/strategy/cohort_ladder.py')})
   return port,filtered,stats
  bt.prepare_signal_and_port_cfg=prepare
  sys.argv=['run_pred_backtest.py','--pred',str(pred),'--config',str(config),'--note',note,'--skip-pred-copy']
  bt.main()
  created=[p for p in result_root.iterdir() if p.name not in before and p.name.endswith(note)]
  assert len(created)==1,created
  session=created[0];link=read(session/'run_01/mlruns_link.json')
  report_path=ROOT/link['backtest_artifacts']/'artifacts/portfolio_analysis/report_normal_1day.pkl'
  report=pd.read_pickle(report_path);assert len(report)==1454 and report.index.is_unique
  assert str(report.index.min().date())=='2020-08-03' and str(report.index.max().date())=='2026-07-31'
  regimes=S5/'configs/monthly_regime_labels_eval_window_v1.csv'
  metrics=summarize_stability(report,load_regime_labels(regimes))
  report.to_pickle(BT/'data'/f'{rule}-account.pkl');report.to_csv(BT/'data'/f'{rule}-account.csv')
  net=(1+report['return']-report['cost']).cumprod();bench=(1+report['bench']).cumprod()
  metrics.update(session_dir=str(session.relative_to(ROOT)),portable_report=str((BT/'reports'/f'{rule}-account.html').relative_to(ROOT)),nav_curve=[[str(d.date()),float(n),float(b)] for d,n,b in zip(report.index,net,bench)])
  doc={'schema_version':1,'model_ref':MODEL_ID,'seeds':SEEDS,'data_version':'2026-11-03','evaluation_mode':'historical_selection_window','source_prediction':fp(pred),'source_report':fp(report_path),'session_dir':str(session.relative_to(ROOT)),'ensemble':metrics,'regime_coverage':{'total_days':len(report),'labeled_days':sum(x['n_days'] for x in metrics['regimes'].values()),'unlabeled_days':0},'selection_limitation':'历史选型窗口；固定规则，无策略调参。账户CAGR与模型238/H算术年化不同。相对历史s5还存在模型配方/数据快照差异；同信号v5双规则比较隔离执行规则。','provenance':{'report_csv':fp(BT/'data'/f'{rule}-account.csv'),'regime_labels':fp(regimes),'config':fp(config),'metrics_function':'strategy_stability_metrics.summarize_stability'}}
  assert doc['regime_coverage']['labeled_days']==len(report)
  out=BT/'metrics'/f'{rule}.json';write(out,doc)
  from backtest.scripts.report.build_phase_m_v1_bt_report import render_snapshot
  html=BT/'reports'/f'{rule}-account.html'
  html.write_text(render_snapshot({'doc':doc,'display_name':'v5 '+('真阶梯Top3×H5' if rule=='ladder' else '固定s5同信号对照'),'portable_eval_output':str(out)},output_path=html))
  state=read(PROGRESS);state['jobs'][-1].update(status='succeeded',finished_at=time.time(),evidence=fp(out),session=str(session.relative_to(ROOT)),report=fp(html));write(PROGRESS,state)
  harness('event',{'type':'note','text':'Supplementary success '+job['job_id']+'; canonical metrics '+str(out.relative_to(ROOT))+' SHA '+fp(out)['sha256']})
  print(json.dumps(metrics['full_period'],ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),flush=True)
 except BaseException as e:
  import traceback
  path=BT/'docs'/(job['job_id']+'-failure.json');write(path,{'error':repr(e),'traceback':traceback.format_exc(),'job':job})
  state=read(PROGRESS);state['jobs'][-1].update(status='failed',finished_at=time.time(),evidence=fp(path));write(PROGRESS,state)
  raise
if __name__=='__main__':main()
